home.note: 2026 home: navy jersey; red-white-red yoke stripes over the shoulders, front and back, ending at the yoke seams; NFL shield at the collar; PATRIOTS wordmark with the Flying Elvis under it; white numbers with silver and red trim; Flying Elvis under the swoosh on the sleeves; silver pants with equal red-navy-red side stripes; navy socks; silver helmet, red facemask, navy number on the back, flag on the left rear

away.note: 2026 road: white jersey; red-navy-red yoke stripes; navy PATRIOTS wordmark with the Flying Elvis under it; navy numbers with silver and red trim; navy pants with equal red-white-red side stripes (2026 week 1; the Patriots also wore white pants in week 3 and silver pants in week 4); white socks (every 2026 road game to date); the home helmet

venue.notes: 2026 home venue: Gillette Stadium (the retail model is Gillette too). End zones unpainted with the PATRIOTS wordmark in white outlined in navy (2026 week 2 frames show white letters on the turf; INFERRED which word each end carries, the retail texture is shared by both ends). The midfield Flying Elvis is re-rendered from the official mark (same design as 2004); the HOME OF THE NEW ENGLAND PATRIOTS ribbon and the Gillette Stadium sign are unchanged since 2004 and stay retail. Fan banners carry 2026 players.
